Participants with missing data on hemoglobin, diabetic retinopathy grade will be excluded. Not diagnosed with diabetes will be excluded.

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "diagnosed with diabetes"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" AS "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes"
FROM nhanes.diq_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" AS "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes"
FROM nhanes.diq_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes ON temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes (respondent_sequence_number);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "hemoglobin (g/dl)", "hemoglobin (g/dl)", "hemoglobin (g/dl)"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "hemoglobin_g_dl" AS "hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM nhanes.cbc_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "hemoglobin_g_dl" AS "hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM nhanes.cbc_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl ON temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl (respondent_sequence_number);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "retinopathy grading", "retinopathy grading", "retinopathy grading"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "retinopathy_level_worse_eye" AS "retinopathy_level_worse_eye"
FROM nhanes.opxret_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "retinopathy_level_worse_eye" AS "retinopathy_level_worse_eye"
FROM nhanes.opxret_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye ON temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye (respondent_sequence_number);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "age"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age_in_years_at_screening"
FROM nhanes.demo_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age_in_years_at_screening"
FROM nhanes.demo_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening ON temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening (respondent_sequence_number);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "sex"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_gender;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_gender AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "gender" AS "gender"
FROM nhanes.demo_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "gender" AS "gender"
FROM nhanes.demo_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_gender ON temp_master_gender (respondent_sequence_number);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "race", "race"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_race_hispanic_origin;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_race_hispanic_origin AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "race_hispanic_origin" AS "race_hispanic_origin"
FROM nhanes.demo_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, "race_hispanic_origin" AS "race_hispanic_origin"
FROM nhanes.demo_e;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_race_hispanic_origin ON temp_master_race_hispanic_origin (respondent_sequence_number);

-- ALL UNIQUE PATIENT IDs
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_all_ids;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_all_ids AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes
UNION
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl
UNION
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye
UNION
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening
UNION
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_gender
UNION
SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM temp_master_race_hispanic_origin;

-- Add index to the main ID table for the final join
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_all_ids_respondent_sequence_number ON temp_all_ids (respondent_sequence_number);

-- FINAL MASTER TABLE
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS final_master_table;
CREATE TABLE final_master_table AS
SELECT
    a.respondent_sequence_number,
    t0."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
    t1."hemoglobin_g_dl",
    t2."retinopathy_level_worse_eye",
    t3."age_in_years_at_screening",
    t4."gender",
    t5."race_hispanic_origin"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_retinopathy_level_worse_eye t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_gender t4 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t4.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_race_hispanic_origin t5 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t5.respondent_sequence_number;

CREATE INDEX idx_final_master_respondent_sequence_number    
    ON final_master_table (respondent_sequence_number);
-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients diagnosed with diabetes
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes';

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing hemoglobin (g/dl)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."hemoglobin_g_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing retinopathy grading
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."retinopathy_level_worse_eye" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age
-- Extract age from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex
-- Extract sex from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race
-- Map race to specified categories
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE f."race_hispanic_origin"
    WHEN 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
    WHEN 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
    WHEN 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican american'
    WHEN 'Other Hispanic' THEN 'other hispanic'
    WHEN 'Other Race - Including Multi-Racial' THEN 'other'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "race"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Hemoglobin (g/dl)
-- Extract raw hemoglobin values for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Calculate tertile cutoffs for hemoglobin within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.3333) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "hemoglobin_g_dl") AS tertile1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.6666) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "hemoglobin_g_dl") AS tertile2
FROM temp_hemoglobin_raw;

-- Assign patients to hemoglobin tertile groups
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_g_dl AS
SELECT h."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN h."hemoglobin_g_dl" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN h."hemoglobin_g_dl" <= (SELECT tertile1 FROM temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs) THEN 'T1: <=33%'
    WHEN h."hemoglobin_g_dl" <= (SELECT tertile2 FROM temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs) THEN 'T2: >33% and <=66%'
    ELSE 'T3: >66%'
  END AS "hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM temp_hemoglobin_raw h;

-- 4.5 Retinopathy Grading
-- Map retinopathy grading to binary outcome
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_retinopathy_grading AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."retinopathy_level_worse_eye" = 'No retinopathy' THEN '0'
    WHEN f."retinopathy_level_worse_eye" = 'No retinopathy but PRP laser' THEN '0'
    WHEN f."retinopathy_level_worse_eye" IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE '1'
  END AS "retinopathy_grading"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  age."age",
  sex."sex",
  race."race",
  hgb."hemoglobin_g_dl",
  ret."retinopathy_grading"
FROM temp_cohort c
LEFT JOIN temp_age age ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = age."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN temp_sex sex ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = sex."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN temp_race race ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = race."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN temp_hemoglobin_g_dl hgb ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = hgb."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN temp_retinopathy_grading ret ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = ret."respondent_sequence_number";
